notes.title: BEYOND MINIMALISM receives FREEdom
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

This game is too old and pretty outdated. I decide to make it free. And there are two reasons:
1) I'm working on my brand Half-Face Games which will contain only free games.
2) I believe every game should become free after sell time was over.

New players would play this game and our community will grow, I hope.

Also, if anyone thought the game wasn't worth $4, they'll be able to play it for free starting September 12th.

This game is experimental with new gaming experience. Not for everyone, but you could try!
